name: Translate
summary: Translate on the shelf, on your Mac, offline or with your AI
description: Type or paste text on the shelf and translate it between any two languages you choose. Apple's on-device models do the work entirely on your Mac, so nothing leaves it; when you want more, you can point the droplet at your own AI provider instead. Auto-detect the source language, swap languages in one click, translate while typing, and copy or paste results.
